short_description.text: King of Edom — Moses sent messengers to him (NUM 20:14). Of the tribe of Edomite.
Adoni-bezek — the lord of Bezek (JDG 1:5) whose thumbs and big toes were cut off (JDG 1:6).
Cushan-rishathaim — Israel sold into his hands for eight years (JDG 3:8) because of Israel's idolatry (JDG 3:7).
Eglon — Israel sold into his hands for eighteen years (JDG 3:14) because Israel again did evil in the sight of the LORD (JDG 3:12).
Ehud — raised up by the LORD as a deliverer for Israel (JDG 3:15) who killed Eglon (JDG 3:21). Of the tribe of Benjamin.
Gera — a Benjamite, father of Ehud (JDG 3:15). Of the tribe of Benjamin.
Shamgar — struck down six hundred Philistines with an oxgoad (JDG 3:31).
Anath — father of Shamgar (JDG 3:31).
Deborah — a prophetess and judge in Israel (JDG 4:4).
Lappidoth — husband of Deborah (JDG 4:4).
Abinoam — father of Barak (JDG 4:6).
Heber — the Kenite, husband of Jael (JDG 4:11) who killed Sisera (JDG 4:21).
Jael — wife of Heber the Kenite (JDG 4:17) who killed Sisera (JDG 4:21).
Joash — the angel of the Lord sat under his oak in Ophrah (JDG 6:11). Of the tribe of Manasseh.
Purah — servant of Gideon (JDG 7:10).
Oreb — leader of Midian (JDG 7:25).
Zeeb — leader of Midian (JDG 7:25).
Zebah — King of Midian (JDG 8:3).
Zalmunna — King of Midian (JDG 8:3).
Jether — firstborn son of Gideon (JDG 8:20). Of the tribe of Manasseh.
Abimelech — son of Gideon (Jerubbaal) by a concubine in Shechem (JDG 8:31) who killed his brothers. Of the tribe of Manasseh.
Jotham — youngest son of Gideon (Jerubbaal) (JDG 9:5). Of the tribe of Manasseh.
Gaal — son of Ebed whom the men of Shechem trusted (JDG 9:26).
Ebed — father of Gaal (JDG 9:26).
Zebul — the ruler of Shechem (JDG 9:30).
Tola — a descendant of Issachar who arose to save Israel (JDG 10:1). Of the tribe of Issachar.
Puah — a descendant of Issachar and father of Tola (JDG 10:1). Of the tribe of Issachar.
Dodo — father of Puah (JDG 10:1). Of the tribe of Issachar.
Jair — a Gileadite who judged Israel for twenty-two years (JDG 10:3).
Gilead — the father of Jephthah with a harlot (JDG 11:1).

entity_profiles.preferred_name: King of the sons of Ammon

short_description.text: King of the sons of Ammon — the king of Ammon at the time of the judges (JDG 11:12).
Ibzan — judge of Israel for seven years (JDG 12:8).
Elon — descendant of Zebulun who judged Israel (JDG 12:11). Of the tribe of Zebulun.
Abdon — son of Hillel who judged Israel for eight years (JDG 12:13).
Hillel — father of Abdon (JDG 12:13).
Manoah — a Danite man from Zorah (JDG 13:2), father of Samson (JDG 13:24). Of the tribe of Dan.
Delilah — a woman who Samson loved (JDG 16:4) who betrayed him (JDG 16:18).
Micah — (JDG 17:1) who stole 1100 pieces of silver from his mother (JDG 17:2).
Jonathan — priest of the Danites (JDG 18:30).
Gershom — father of Jonathan, son of Manasseh (JDG 18:30).
Manasseh — father of Gershom (JDG 18:30).
